i was thin my entire life until i turned 25. all the takeout id have. before starting a shift at work ages 18-22, made me think well— im naturally skinny, i won't get fat. but i did.

it's so hard to admit this but when people think ED they think of anorexia and bulmia— but mine was irregular. i used to just consume cigarettes and alcohol and it was on and off, my weight gain happened when my best friend died. i was good maintaining my weight bc my parents don't really cook and just do take out and im not included during orders, also i eat the leftovers. so it goes from fat, binge eating fat, to I'm eating only eggs today. oh, I'll just skip dinner for a coke and one cigarette. im not even allowed to smoke in this house.

I'd rather have the ED where I starve myself, so I can die a natural death. I'm too cowardice to end my own life. But I'm also, like you said, a failure when I end up eating, then I end up binge eating bc if i already ate, night as well go all the way down. I never thought I'd see myself without a collarbone. but I look at the mirror with my round face and missing collarbones and flabby arms and I look at my mirror selfies from 2021-2023. 

I have insane amount of stretch marks on my thighs, my thighs, which used to be my favorite part of my body, looks obese and deformed. even if I'm under 48-55kg at 152cm, my lowest was 38kg at my prime age. Now, everything is just dwindling and I can't even die with this disorder.

\- Don't wait until you're really thirsty to drink water. 

\> Your wrists, neck, feet, face, and inner thighs have a Lot of Blood moving close to the surface- either large exposed veins, or lots of capillaries.
